stage: Section 6 method freeze, synthetic fixtures only

historical_m9b_tier1_draft.note: ARP-2B remains the historical synthetic draft. Its blocked register is not rewritten, and this contract does not treat that draft as production-ready.

reused_validators.behavior: Candidate columns stay id,sequence. The target-free profile still accepts only compatibility 'not evaluated' and shuffle pass or fail.
CSV parsing, opaque-id checks, canonical A/C/G/U checks, finite aptamer-likeness checks, and target-free token checks are reused. ARP-1 is not modified.

not_reused.m9b3_export_validator: M9B-3 accepts strong, moderate, weak, and U+2014 in addition to the target-free tokens. Section 6 keeps the narrower ARP-1 target-free profile.
not_reused.m9b2_candidate_ids: M9B-2 blinds generator-condition memberships under domain m9b2-candidate-id-v1. Section 6 uses a separate domain and does not import that preparer.

uniform_controls.parents: one exact-length i.i.d. A/C/G/U control per parent
uniform_controls.integer_rendering: canonical decimal text with no sign and no leading zeros
uniform_controls.byte_rule: consume digest bytes below 252 and map byte % 4 with nucleotide order A,C,G,U; discard bytes 252-255
uniform_controls.rejection: a draw matching the caller-supplied known-core inventory or a previously accepted control is discarded
uniform_controls.inventory_contains_input_parents: the caller-supplied known-core inventory must contain every input parent source digest before a control is drawn
uniform_controls.parent_order: ascending sequence_core_sha256 so input order does not change the accepted controls

blinding.secret: caller-supplied 32 bytes; not embedded in code, configuration, manifests, tests, or Git
blinding.id_preimage: length-delimited domain and canonical sequence; the secret is the HMAC key
blinding.order_algorithm: domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256 of the canonical sequence under the same caller-supplied 32-byte secret, full digest, ascending
blinding.order_secret: the same caller-supplied 32-byte secret; the implementation does not accept a second ordering key
blinding.pair_rule: each pair contains exactly one eval_core and one paired_uniform_shuffle sharing parent_core_id, cluster_id, and length
blinding.class_label_counts: eval_core populates real_memberships; paired_uniform_shuffle populates controls

statistics.aptamer_likeness: finite decimal in the closed interval [0, 1], endpoints included

export_ranks.retained_gaps: when technical failures omit rows, increasing rank must correspond to non-increasing score and ascending candidate id on score ties

statistics.primary_paired_effect: median of eval_core minus paired_uniform_shuffle score differences
statistics.auroc: complete pairs, positive class eval_core, tie credit 0.5, values below 0.5 preserved
statistics.shuffle_pass_rate_denominator: rows with a valid exported pass or fail value
statistics.paired_shuffle_difference: pairs with valid values for both members, eval_core minus paired_uniform_shuffle

secondary_test.name: wilcoxon_signed_rank
secondary_test.ties: average ranks of tied absolute differences
secondary_test.variance_identity: sum(r_i^2)/4 for the average ranks of the nonzero absolute differences
secondary_test.statistic: sum of the ranks of strictly positive differences

bootstrap.unit: observed unique cluster ids, drawn with replacement, same count as observed
bootstrap.multiplicity: every eligible complete pair in a selected cluster is included once per draw of that cluster
bootstrap.interval: 95 percent type-7 quantiles at 0.025 and 0.975 of defined replicates
bootstrap.minimum_for_paired_auroc_and_bootstrap: at least two complete pairs from at least two clusters

analyzed_bytes.candidate_upload: every summary records the SHA-256 and byte count of the exact candidate-upload bytes
analyzed_bytes.downloaded_export: every summary records the SHA-256 and byte count of the exact downloaded-export bytes
analyzed_bytes.when_optional_artifacts_empty: both records remain present when the optional raw-artifact list is empty

raw_run_artifacts.capture: optional run artifacts stay separate from the analyzed upload and export bytes; every available optional artifact is hashed; unavailable roles are recorded and are not replaced
raw_run_artifacts.five_component_fields_note: These are the v3.5 Tier 1 checklist names. They are not an observed or frozen deployed artifact schema.
raw_run_artifacts.five_component_table: unavailable. A JSON document that declares the expected scorer and role strings is not verified. Duplicate, unexpected, incomplete, or merely self-declared rows do not receive populated_from_verified_artifact. No production schema is invented.

component_acceptance_gate.when: the deployed AptaRank UI exposes component values
steps: capture and hash the untouched artifact
review and freeze its real schema
enforce unique candidate ids and reconciliation against the analyzed export and private key
compute a compact class-level descriptive table from the exported component values

closed_register_from_historical_draft.note: These ARP-2B blockers are closed by this Section 6 contract. The historical draft file still lists them as unresolved and is not edited.

ids.U22: SHA-256 counter stream, master seed 42, nucleotide order A,C,G,U
ids.U23: caller-supplied SHA-256 inventory of corrected primary-corpus unique cores; later production uses TRAIN, VALIDATION, REF, and EVAL
ids.U24: attempt index and block counter, attempts 0-9999, fail closed
ids.U26: caller-supplied 32-byte HMAC secret; ordering is a domain-separated HMAC under that same secret
ids.U29: higher aptamer-likeness is favourable for these summaries
ids.U31: primary effect is the median paired difference; the mean is descriptive
ids.U33: pass/fail rows for class rates; both-valid pairs for the paired difference
ids.U34: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, zero_method wilcox, average ranks, normal approximation, no continuity correction
ids.U35: cluster resampling with replacement and multiplicity
ids.U37: undefined replicates are counted and excluded
ids.U38: two complete pairs from two clusters, and 9500 defined replicates for an interval
